privacy: No screenshot bytes are committed. Only SHA256 hashes and trader-confirmed semantic labels are stored.
trader_statement: These are trades I took, and I switched to 1 minute to show how the momentum candles look when I take a trade.
semantic_label: The trader's real entry momentum is a live 1-minute directional-control sequence at or through the relevant structure. The important look is persistent directional progress with limited giveback/overlap and closes holding near the favorable extreme, often across consecutive or near-consecutive 1-minute candles. The trader may enter while the parent 5-minute candle is still forming once that force is proven. A single temporarily large candle is not enough if it gives back or loses control.

replay_sampling_use.purpose: Prefer more trader-representative momentum opportunities in fidelity calibration.
replay_sampling_use.allowed: Rank or filter only by causal setup/force geometry known at the decision clock; do not use trade outcome.
